title: Verify committed project creation before resuming continuous work
summary: Use stored WorkItem context normalization and require an exact persisted project and organization attachment to recover an uncertain project creation.
reusable_steps: Use stored WorkItem context normalization and require an exact persisted project and organization attachment to recover an uncertain project creation
expected_outcome: For an organization-scoped WorkItem, compare the normalized admitted context with the stored context. Validate objective links before recording a new project effect. When an interrupted creation has an exact committed project and matching organization membership, carry that verification forward without replaying creation. Keep the uncertainty when proof is absent. Verify the next three owner ticks and compare project and child mission creation counts.
